title: Valuation by comparables
intro: Estimate in XOF based on nearby comparable observations. The result is always a range, never a single value.

validation.areaSqm: Area must be greater than 0 and at most 1,000,000 sqm.
validation.radiusMeters: Radius must be an integer between 100 and 50,000 m.
validation.periodMonths: Period must be an integer between 1 and 120 months.

warning.title: Warning
warning.fallback: Insufficient sample (n={count}). The estimate is indicative; caution is advised.
